Biodiversity & ANP Datasets

Core datasets providing access to Peru’s protected area registry, flora, fauna, occurrences, and global biogeography.

anp_list
Official List of State-Protected Natural Areas in Peru
anp_species_flora
Standardized Flora Species of Peruvian Natural Protected Areas (BioANP)
anp_species_fauna
Standardized Fauna Species of Peruvian Natural Protected Areas (BioANP)
anp_species_occ
Species Occurrence Records in Peru's Protected Natural Areas
anp_especies_distr
Biogeographic Distribution of Flora Species (WCVP / WGSRPD Level 3)
